title: External-Review Ledger Row
description: One row of ledger.json — the canonical, frozen work-set + live status for a single finding in the external-review pattern. This file defines the SHAPE and value domains ONLY; the field SEMANTICS (provisional_severity vs. severity, the verdict->disposition map, the tier/agreement/seat rules, the status lifecycle) live in flow-external-review (§3, §5). The row is written INCREMENTALLY across phases, so only schema_version/id/title/status are required; every other field is filled in as its phase resolves. `verdict` is the FULL arbiter set (finding-verdict.schema.json); `provisional_severity` and `severity` are the ONE anchored scale (severity.schema.json).

schema_version.description: Contract version. Pinned so a consumer can detect a shape change. The row is durable (written incrementally across phases) and may outlive a revision.

id.description: Finding id (e.g. F-03, or a split sub-row F-03a/F-03b).

title.description: Short human-readable label for the finding.

source.description: Which review pass(es)/reviewer(s) raised it — merged on dedup.

comment_id.description: The originating inline/issue comment id, when applicable — a union because inline.jsonl (flow-external-review §0/PHASE 0) stores GitHub's comment id and GitLab's full discussion id in the same field despite their differing native types.

locations.description: One or more cited file:line sites.

passes.description: Per-pass provenance map (which passes carried this finding and their raw labels).

agreement.description: Cross-source agreement classification set in Phase 1.

tier.description: Triage tier. Criteria and the panel rule live in flow-external-review §5.1.

panel_required.description: Whether a PRO+CON panel (and possibly the arbiter) is required for this row.

seat.description: The single routed adjudication seat. Scalar; the routing and splitting rules live in flow-external-review §2b.

provisional_severity.description: Phase-1 triage hint mapped from the external label. Semantics — what it feeds, and its distinction from `severity` — live in flow-external-review §5.3.

verdict.description: This row's final ruling, driving the disposition (flow-external-review §5.2).

severity.description: Phase-2 evidence-based grade on the anchor scale. Its distinction from `provisional_severity` lives in flow-external-review §5.3.

disposition.description: The outcome derived from the verdict (§5.2).

secondary_actions.description: Additional outcomes beyond the primary disposition, for a compound ruling (flow-external-review §5.2).

resolved_by_commit.description: OPTIONAL — present ONLY when disposition is ALREADY_RESOLVED: the SHA that already fixed the row (flow-external-review §5.2/PHASE 2, not enforced by this schema).

escalation_blocker.description: OPTIONAL — present ONLY when disposition is ESCALATED: the review-arbiter's stated reason it could not decide on the evidence. The one datum the ESCALATE path exists to surface to the human (enforced by flow-external-review §5.2/PHASE 3, not by this schema).

fix_commit.description: SHA of the commit that fixed this row in Phase 5.

comment_url.description: URL of the posted PR response covering this finding.

status.description: Position in the run lifecycle — the full value set (PENDING, JUDGED, then a terminal RESOLVED/TRACK_FOLLOWUP/BLOCKED/ESCALATED) is owned by flow-external-review §11. Kept as a string because the source does not fix a single closed set.
